574-1778-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Memnite is starting in your graveyard.
574-1778-5006-8170.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Memnite spell. Then, activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Memnite, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.
574-1778-5006-8170.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1339-2835-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2835-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

687-4613-5231-8130-8133.description:
Cast Goblin-town Flunkies by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Goblin-town Flunkies enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Goblin-town Flunkies and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Goblin-town Flunkies from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4613-5231-8130-8133.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4184-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Relentless Skaabs
When Relentless Skaabs dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
4184-4247-6972.notes: If Relentless Skaabs starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4677-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

277-1308-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-7175-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-7173.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1116-2946-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2946-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

997-1445-1913-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-1913-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

413-3817-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it, Blasting Station and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
If you returned a creature in step 4, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller token's trigger, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-6798-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6798-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6798-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

560-4017-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-4017-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

589-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
589-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5686-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

2060-2906-4415-6930.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2060-2906-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1350-2793-5256-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

955-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

729-2054-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian
729-2054-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Great Oak Guardian, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Great Oak Guardian for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

2730-4871-5006-5686.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2730-4871-5006-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

372-864-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Eternal Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-864-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3263-3401-5803.manaNeeded: {2}, plus an additional {11} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
3263-3401-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3263-3401-5803.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {14}, minus {1} for each artifact you control for a maximum reduction of {12}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3469-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-5803.description:
Cast Energy Arc by paying {W}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Energy Arc.
Resolve the copy of Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4316-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1329-1379-4809-4853.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1379-4809-4853.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shifting Wall from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

819-1980-4311-5195.description:
Cast any spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Memory Lapse either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Memory Lapse, targeting the original Memory Lapse.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Memory Lapse, countering the original Memory Lapse and putting it on top of your library.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

339-1692-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Jegantha.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
339-1692-2011.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Jegantha with haste that isn't legendary.
Activate the Jegantha token by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

141-2034-2596.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2034-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.
